subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: Should operators paired before `operator.questions` existed receive that new question-read/resolve authority automatically, or must they explicitly re-pair or approve a scoped upgrade?
rationale: The choice changes the authority of persisted device tokens and determines whether existing users get native question support automatically, so it cannot safely be inferred from a code-only fix.

options.title: Explicit scoped upgrade
options.body: Keep existing stored grants unchanged and present a visible re-pair or permission-upgrade recovery flow before enabling native question access.

options.title: Migrate trusted paired operators
options.body: Add `operator.questions` to qualifying existing paired operator tokens with narrow migration, audit evidence, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Defer native question scope
options.body: Land only the surfaces that do not need persisted paired-device question authority, then return with an approved migration design.

recommendation.title: Explicit scoped upgrade
recommendation.body: Keep existing stored grants unchanged and present a visible re-pair or permission-upgrade recovery flow before enabling native question access.
